messages:
jamie_sales: Quick sync w/ @alice_cust — they're kicking off a POC next week. Main asks: BYOK/HSM integration timeline, key rotation policy & automation, impact on per-request latency, and whether Redwood can sign attestation for key custody. Also pricing question: separate billing for BYOK proxy calls vs model inference? cc: @ana_se @sarah_security

ana_se: Re: POC scope — propose 2-week sandbox: 1) BYOK handshake + test encrypt/decrypt flow, 2) key rotation dry-run (no downtime), 3) throughput test at 1000 req/s. Need customer to provide CloudHSM endpoint or cert bundle. Suggest SOW snippet: 'SE will validate CMK handshake and rotation procedure in staging, measure <50ms median key fetch latency across 4 regions.'

mike_enginfra: From infra side: key-proxy adds ~5-12ms median if proxied via Dedicated cluster in same AZ; cross-region adds 20-40ms. We recommend prefix caching to reduce key fetch QPS. For HSM-backed decrypts we'll need pinned capacity — estimate 2 vHSMs for 1000 rps during POC.

sarah_security: Security Qs — we can provide KMS attestation letter (standard template). For security questionnaire, answer for 'customer-managed keys' is: 'Yes — Redwood supports customer-managed keys via KMS/HSM proxy + rotation; keys never stored unencrypted in our control plane; audit logs available.' Need customer to sign AAD + data processing addendum.

alice_cust: Good. A few clarifications: 1) can rotation be automatic with zero downtime? 2) what's the rollback process if rotation fails? 3) is BYOK compatible with our on-prem HSM behind firewall?

ana_se: 1) Yes — we support canary rotation + automatic fallback to previous key variant. 2) Rollback = automatic fallback + manual rollback API: POST /v1/keys/rollback {key_id}. 3) On-prem HSM OK if network allows outbound TLS to our proxy; we can also run Private deployment for air-gapped env.

jamie_sales: Pricing note — BYOK proxy is billed per proxy call at $0.0008/call during POC; Dedicated commit priced separately. If they opt for Private, billing is license + infra usage. I flagged this for pricing team.

mike_enginfra: Also: test script we run: ```bash
curl -X POST https://proxy.redwood.ai/handshake -d '{"key_id":"acme-1"}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer <token>'
``` — we'll generate cert and expected vectors. Sharing runbook in 1hr.

deploy-bot: New runbook uploaded: https://redwood.co/runbooks/acme-byo-rotation.pdf

ana_se: Action items: 1) Jamie to confirm POC dates by EOD. 2) Alice to share cert bundle + questionnaire. 3) Mike to attach latency/cost estimates. 4) Sarah to attach attestation template. I'll prepare SOW draft.

jamie_sales: ack. I'll ping pricing + legal. thx :thumbsup:
